headline: Clicks up 17%, CPC up 8% — Saturday profit all but gone
commentary:
### The day
- **$709 NP at 1.9% margin** — the leads were fine, the clicks were dear.
  - NP: $709 v $4,397 last Sat
  - Eight-Saturday average NP: $4,330
- Cost was the problem: nearly 40% above a normal Saturday, volume and value decent.
  - Cost: $37,387 v $26,816 eight-Sat average
  - EPL: $18.62 v $16.45 average
  - Processed: 2,046 v 1,893 average
- October is still well clear of September, on a quarter less spend.
  - MTD NP: $132,843 v $113,300 last month
  - MTD NM: 14.4% v 9.8%
  - MTD cost: $792,724 v $1,048,304
### What drove it
- Search bought 17% more clicks and paid $12.52 a go.
  - Search clicks: 2,926 v 2,503
  - Search CPC: $12.52 v $11.57
  - Search cost: $36,628 v $28,961
- Lead rate slipped too, so cost per lead ran well above value.
  - Search CPL: $25.17 v $20.67
  - Search EPL: $24.19 v $22.25
  - Search NP: -$1,426 v +$2,205
- The extra money went into cash_advance, bad_credit and amount, all up hard.
  - cash_advance: $3,206 v $1,463
  - bad_credit: $2,340 v $1,015
  - amount: $8,221 v $6,178
- **albert.com leaning in across the auction** — we held share and paid for it.
  - albert account IS: 43.9% v 35.2%
  - Our IS on amount: 26.4% v 35.1%
  - Abs-top at 16:00: 12.5% v 8.0%
### Tests
| Test | Set-up | Spend 24/10 | Spend wk ago | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Off SAs onto tROAS | personal + competitor | $1,625 | $1,387 | — |
| speed walk-down | high target, stepping down | $1,217 | $505 | — |
| Scavenger pair | tROAS plus tCPA copy | $1,530 | $1,668 | — |
- speed more than doubled its spend, at the dearest clicks on the account.
  - speed CPC: $19.63 v $17.43
  - speed IS: 10.3% v 10.0%
- Scavengers were live on a Saturday again, though the plan has them dark.
  - Scavenger spend: $1,530 v $1,668 last Sat
watch: Search CPC is the number we're tracking — $12.52 on the day against $12.07 month-to-date.
albert.com's share grab, up 8.7 points at account level and gaining in amount, speed and bad_credit.
Weekend scavenger spend, $1,530 on a day the campaigns are meant to be scheduled off.
